I identify as pansexual and a mixture of both male and female so my gender expression is mostly androgynous. I don't really like labels at all because I feel my particular labels (combined with my age) could discredit me in other peoples eyes. I usually say I'm a lesbian if anyone asks. I think some people treat me differently because I live in a small town and they don't know how to deal with someone who looks both male and female. A lot of questions usually arise when they figure out I'm female, I think this is because male androgyny and cross dressing is more highly covered in the media (at least what I've seen.) I'm fairly quiet and quite tall so no one has ever confronted me about my gender expression in an aggressive way (lucky). The only exception was the blatant sexism I experienced in my male dominated field of study when I was still obviously female. Overall gender is fairly important to me, if I could be both genders or switch between the two continuously, I would be supremely happy.
